# A grey field stone: a jittered, squashed icosahedron, 1.0 x 0.8 x 0.5 m. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0.16
scale 1.0 0.8 0.6
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.07 --seed 4
mode object
material new Stone --base-color 0.459 0.443 0.380
material assign Stone
shade flat
export rock.glb
